architecture.summary: The MCP gateway tells the cold start of a new tenant from a restart, for the SO-12 release rehearsal finding of 31 October 2026 (release record 3.7, item 5): a new tenant refused connections for about 75 s after its live record, and each refused call wrote the ERROR line that the Axiom monitor Tenant restart matches. Now a refused connection less than 2 minutes after the last change of a live row gets the starting words, 'Your workspace is not ready yet. Try again in 15 seconds.' (a body without a request gets 503 with Retry-After: 15), and one INFO line 'MCP gateway tenant starting:' with the organization and secondsSinceChange. A reset connection, a broken answer, HTTP 502, a failure after the first answer byte, and a refused connection from 2 minutes on stay restarts, with the ERROR line 'MCP gateway tenant restart:' (cause refused, connection, or http-502) and the restart words, so a memory kill of a new tenant still alerts. The time comes from the registry read: the SQL adapter of tenants selects the time since updated_at by the clock of the database, TenantLookup keeps the change time in its copy and gives the time since it at each find, and the registry port of the gateway (GatewayRoute) carries it to the live forward of mcp. The monitor query stays the same. No component, edge, public module, declaration snapshot, migration, setting, or deployment changes; the gateway call scenario of the registry gains the cold start branch.
